# SpinKagomeComputeSpinSpinCorrelations

Module: **Spin** · directory: `Spin/src/Programs` · binary: `Spin/src/Programs/SpinKagomeComputeSpinSpinCorrelations`

```text
SpinKagomeComputeSpinSpinCorrelations, version 0.01

Usage: SpinKagomeComputeSpinSpinCorrelations [options] 

Options:

system options:
    -i, --input-state : name of the file corresponding to the state |Psi_R> (the order parameter being <Psi_L|c^+c^+|Psi_R>
    --bond : calculate bond-bond correlations
    --only-x : only evalute a given x position (negative if all kx sectors have to be computed) (default value = -1)
    --only-y : only evalute a given y position sector (negative if all ky sectors have to be computed) (default value = -1)

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (replacing the vec extension with ent extension

tools options:

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

precalculation options:
    --save-hilbert : save Hilbert space description in the indicated file and exit (only available for the Sz symmetry)
    --load-hilbert : load Hilbert space description from the indicated file (only available for the Sz symmetry)

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
